text.zh-CN: 阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）是睡着后上气道反复变窄或关闭，使气流减少或暂停；身体反复醒一下来重新呼吸，睡眠因此被打断。
text.en: Obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) repeatedly narrows or closes the upper airway during sleep. Airflow decreases or stops, and brief awakenings reopen the airway, fragmenting sleep.

supports.locator: What Is Sleep Apnea? obstructive versus central
supports.assessment: NHLBI supports recurrent upper-airway blockage/airflow reduction; NG202 opening definition specifically supports arousal/lightening of sleep and fragmentation.
NHLBI supports recurrent upper-airway blockage/airflow reduction; NG202 opening definition specifically supports arousal/lightening of sleep and fragmentation.

text.zh-CN: 常见线索是大声打鼾、旁人看到呼吸停顿、憋醒，以及白天困倦或注意力下降；本人可能不记得夜间醒过。
text.en: Clues include loud snoring, witnessed pauses, gasping awakenings and daytime sleepiness or poor concentration. The sleeper may not remember waking.

supports.assessment: NHS supports witnessed pauses, gasping, repeated awakening and daytime concentration; NHLBI Symptoms supports unrecognized sleep symptoms and learning/attention impact.
NHS supports witnessed pauses, gasping, repeated awakening and daytime concentration; NHLBI Symptoms supports unrecognized sleep symptoms and learning/attention impact.

text.zh-CN: 鼾声本身不能判断是否有OSA，也不能判断严重程度。确诊依靠睡眠评估和适当监测，治疗目标包括改善夜间呼吸、白天功能和安全。
text.en: Snoring alone does not establish OSA or its severity. Sleep assessment and appropriate monitoring guide diagnosis; treatment targets nighttime breathing, daytime function and safety.

supports.assessment: NHS Getting tested requires monitored assessment/AHI rather than snoring alone; NHLBI Sleep study distinguishes type and treatment. Goal wording synthesizes treatment and safety information, not a promise of cardiovascular cure.
